acceptance_criteria: **Scores.** One fidelity run per round covers all 8 boards in the Boards table: six live URLs and the two driver-frozen record pages. Every board has `coverageWithExceptions` = 100 and `visual` ≥ 90. A board at 70 or more but below 90 passes only with a D-83 waiver signed by the design engineer for that board in `fidelity-exceptions.json`, and only when the UI reviewer's side-by-side reading finds no fixable gap. No board passes under 70. — verify: the commands exit 0; `round-<N>/fidelity/scores.txt` lists board, width, coverage, visual, pass and waiver; a re-run of `drive-states.mjs` reproduces the frozen pages.

**Exceptions limited.** Each entry has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason` and `approved_by`, and maps to a Conflicts number. None covers a value the data can supply (a name, date, reference, tag, gap or sentence). — verify: file content; build.md.

**The row opens the item.** On `/projects/P-0101/delivery`, "Handover to Support" links to `/work/W-3704`, and the sub-nav's "Handover" links to the same. Every other row, tag and date is unchanged. `P-0101.json` differs from dlv-00 by exactly one added `work_id` line. — verify: the updated `delivery-overview.test.tsx` and `delivery-release-mock.test.ts` assertions; `git diff frontend/mock/fixtures/projects/P-0101.json`.
**Four states from data.** `/work/W-3701`, `/work/W-3703`, `/work/W-3704` and `/work/W-3705` each show their fixture's status label and tone, sections, steps, Next and links, and nothing else.

**The hold has no controls.** W-3702 shows "Review needed?" as "Unknown". It shows the returned Next sentence and no button, link, form or step of any kind in the workspace (beyond the frame's tabs and back link). A recording `fetch` sees no POST. — verify: component test.

**Publish writes once and claims nothing before the re-read.** On W-3701, pressing Publish sends one POST `/api/v1/work/W-3701/steps` with `{step: "publish", expected_revision: 1, idempotency_key}` and CSRF. A double press sends one; the mock log shows one send for the key. The words "published 08 Apr" appear only after the re-read serves `W-3701.next.json`. — verify: e2e with recorded requests and `GET /__mock/workspace-log`; component test with a held re-read showing no "published" until it resolves.
**Each uncertain path has a fixture and ends without a resend.**

**Draft v2 is Tola's work, never a verified result.** On W-3704, "Ask Tola to draft v2" sends one step. It shows "Waiting: Tola is drafting v2.", and then the re-read's "Drafting v2" status with the gaps still OPEN. No green banner, "v2 published" or "acknowledged" appears. — verify: component test; e2e.
**The form comes only from the response.** On W-3703 the form shows:
**Recording sends one guarded write after the proof.** With Gaps found, two gap lines, a time and `support-reply-10apr.pdf`, the network shows, in order:
one POST `/api/v1/cases/P-0101/evidence`;

one POST `/api/v1/tasks/T-3703/response` with `{expected_revision: 1, who: "R-3701", action: "changes_requested", responded_at, evidence_id, attested: true, case_revision, version_id: "V-3701", gaps: ["No contact for the credit bureau outage", "Runbook misses the nightly export restart"]}` and CSRF.
**No success before the re-read, on every path.**

**Recorded under the PM's name, never as Support.** The notice and the acknowledged banner attribute the record to the signed-in person, as returned. No text says Support logged in, signed or sent through the factory. `grep -rniE "logged in|signed in as|support (sent|signed)" frontend/src/features/response/SupportHandoverForm.tsx frontend/src/features/workspace` returns nothing. — verify: component test; grep.

**Verified only from the backend (INV-AGENT).** W-3711, whose Tola item "Support acknowledged the handover" is done, shows no green banner, no "Handover acknowledged" and no closure link. W-3705's banner is green only because `status.tone` is `verified`: a copy with the same text and tone `person` draws the warning banner. — verify: component tests.

**Unknown, not zero.** On W-3710 the unknown gap reads "Unknown", and Tola's checklist has no time line. W-3702's "Review needed?" reads "Unknown". Nothing shows blank, "0" or "-". "GAPS · 2" is drawn only from the returned label: a copy with three gap items and the label "Gaps · 2" still shows "Gaps · 2". The browser counts nothing. — verify: component tests.
**Links only from data.** "See what closure needs" appears only from a `work` link with a valid `work_id`. A copy with `work_id: "../x"`, or with no link, draws nothing. — verify: component test.
**Access.**

**Phone.** At 390, each state is one column, with the desktop sections in the desktop order (Conflicts 6), and there is no sideways scroll. Every target is at least 44px tall, measured: buttons, the segmented options, the date-time field, the file button, row links, standalone links, and the proof chip's remove "×", which is also at least 44px wide (D-92c). Record reply sits in the pinned action bar. — verify: e2e at 390 measuring `getBoundingClientRect`, including `.resp-chip__remove` after an upload.

**Accessibility.** There are no axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 1440 or 390 on W-3701 to W-3705, W-3702, W-3706.next, W-3709, the form with a 422, and the no-access view. Every field is labelled. Errors are announced. The remove button is named "Remove support-reply-10apr.pdf". Tags and status are text, not colour only. Focus is visible and returns to the page heading after a record. Nothing animates under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`. — verify: `e2e/support-handover.spec.ts`.

**Tokens and components only.** New UI imports from `@/components` (`Panel`, `Button`, `Tag`, `Callout`, `Link`, `Unknown`) and F-18's response parts. It adds no local button, tag, panel, segmented control or upload. `grep -nE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(|hsl\("` on this feature's CSS diff returns nothing. — verify: diff and grep.
**Mock matches the contract.**

**Contract not extended.** `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**` (including `schema.d.ts`), `apps/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**`, `src/shell/**`, `src/features/decide/**`, `src/features/projects/**` or the protected paths. No existing fixture is edited except the one `work_id` key in `P-0101.json`. `gaps` exists only as a PROPOSAL-marked optional field in `features/response/contract.ts` and in the mock. Every proposal is listed in build.md. — verify: `git diff --stat`; grep for `PROPOSAL` beside `gaps`; build.md.

**Existing tests green.** `delivery/checks.sh` passes. The response, team-input, workspace, work-item, delivery-overview, release-gates, engagement-planning, decide and project-tab tests and their e2e specs pass. No assertion is removed or loosened. The only assertion edits are the two Handover-row expectations, which now expect `W-3704`. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`; the e2e output in build.md; `git diff` of `frontend/tests/` and `frontend/e2e/`.

**No overclaim.** build.md and the PR carry the "What is sent, and what stays held" section: contract mock only, nothing sent to Support, no review rule set, and G-48-1 and G-48-2 open for the backend. — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: Medium for part 1. The page has four states, two step writes (one of them a send), a recorded response with proof and a proposed gaps field, all on the shared F-17 frame and the F-18 response form. That makes it a cross-layer contract with additive proposals (G-48-1 to -3; contract-change). `external-messaging` is ticked because "Publish to Support" is a send with no defined channel (G-48-2). On the mock, nothing is sent, and the existing uncertain and reconcile path covers an unknown result. `product-decision` is ticked because `delivery.handover_review` is a PSL rule that is still Not set; the page only shows the hold. Part 1 has no money, identity, migration or decision authority, so `auth` and `payments` are not ticked. Part 3 will be high risk with `auth` and `payments`: the PMO Lead's closure, the read-only lock, and Finance's open invoices shown next to it. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required because the handover flow and its wording are new to the client.
